prompts.title: Blue Light Aura
prompts.prompt:
Create a sophisticated, high-contrast cinematic editorial portrait that blends modern fashion photography with a futuristic synthwave-inspired aesthetic. The image should feel premium, minimal, and fashion-editorial, with strong visual symmetry and a clear geometric composition.
Subject & Identity

A well-dressed man is framed from mid-torso to head, centered in the composition. His body is slightly angled while remaining mostly forward-facing, creating natural depth while maintaining balance and symmetry. Both hands rest naturally inside his pant pockets. His head is slightly raised with a calm, composed expression and a confident upward gaze. When a reference image is provided, the face, hairstyle, skin texture, and overall identity must closely match the reference, preserving natural proportions and realism without stylization or alteration. Hair appears natural with soft volume and realistic texture. Expression remains neutral, confident, and editorial.
Wardrobe & Styling

The subject wears a sharply tailored dark navy or deep blue suit jacket over a fitted black turtleneck. The suit is clean, structured, and well-pressed, with subtle highlights along lapels and seams. Styling is modern, minimal, and premium. Classic round sunglasses with dark lenses add a contemporary fashion look. A wristwatch may be subtly visible but should not draw attention away from the face.
Lighting & Circular Element

A large cyan-blue neon ring is positioned directly behind the subject, perfectly centered to create a glowing circular halo. The ring produces strong cyan rim lighting along the edges of the hair, ears, jawline, shoulders, and suit silhouette, clearly separating the subject from the dark background. The rim light is strongest along the sides facing the ring and gradually softens toward the front. A soft, low-intensity frontal key light preserves natural skin tones and facial detail, while a subtle fill light gently lifts shadows without reducing cinematic contrast. Shadows remain deep but smooth with gradual tonal transitions.
Color Tone & Atmosphere

The overall color grading is cool, dark, and modern, dominated by teal and cyan tones with low-to-moderate saturation. Shadows fall into deep navy and midnight blue, while highlights carry a clean electric cyan from the neon ring. Skin tones remain natural with a slight cool shift. The background stays minimal and near black-blue, with a soft cyan glow around the ring and controlled bloom. Make the background smooth with no texture or patterns. A subtle layer of atmospheric fog or smoke sits mainly in the lower frame, catching blue light and adding depth without obscuring the subject.
Framing & Composition

Vertical 4:5 aspect ratio. Medium portrait framing. The subject remains fully inside the frame with safe margins on both sides so shoulders and arms are not cropped. Maintain comfortable headroom above the hair. The neon circle remains fully visible and perfectly centered to reinforce symmetry and balance.
Technical Quality

Ultra-realistic photography, cinematic contrast, shallow depth of field, sharp focus on the subject, high dynamic range, natural skin detail, premium fashion editorial quality, clean modern rendering, 8K high-resolution output.
